_doc: doc 05 §3 step 3. 3 units x 4 cards, each card one concept (A1->a1 ...). Round-robin (as in interleave_basic): A1 B1 C1 A2 B2 C2 A3 B3 C3 A4 B4 C4. Pairs: (a1,c4) distance 11 > 3 -> fix; (b1,c1) distance 1 already satisfied; (a2,z9) z9 not in session -> ignored. Fix (a1,c4): the later item C4 (index 11) moves; without it the list is A1 B1 C1 A2 B2 C2 A3 B3 C3 A4 B4 and A1 stays at 0. Insert positions keeping |pos(C4) - pos(A1)| <= 3: pos 0 (C4 A1 B1 ..., 0 adjacencies), pos 1 (A1 C4 B1 C1 ..., 0), pos 2 (A1 B1 C4 C1: C-C adjacency, 1), pos 3 (A1 B1 C1 C4: 1). (b1,c1) stays satisfied at pos 0/1. Tie between pos 0 and 1 -> nearest the old index 11 -> pos 1. Result: A1 C4 B1 C1 A2 B2 C2 A3 B3 C3 A4 B4; no unsatisfied pairs.
